reason: Independent QA identified that unsupported-device or camera-denial failure exposed a separate-segment restart without capability/authorization readmission.
fix: One CaptureStartAdmission policy checks capability, authorized camera, active app, protected data, thermal safety and 512 MB reserve. Native controller applies it before first/next/separate sensor starts, RoomCaptureView/RoomPlan preparation and both sides of asynchronous relocalization. Separate/next/relocalize controls also require current capability and camera authorization. Foreground generation cancellation remains in force.

evidence_reuse: The previous 24 CaptureKit lifecycle/compatibility/plane test inputs are unchanged. This targeted run covers the new independent admission policy; it does not substitute for physical capture permission testing.
